CustomField.description: Is true if Job Type is "Long-Term" and they have completed 365 days since start date. For older records, use old retention formula values
CustomField.formula:
IF( AND( OR( AND(ISPICKVAL(Job_Type__c,"Long-Term"), Retention_Days_Lapsed_Since_Start_FY18__c>=365), One_Year_Retention_Category_FY18__c = "#Retained One Year", One_Year_Retention_Category_FY18__c = "#Retained ETJ" ), Text(Job_Type__c) != "Permanent-Advancement", Text(Job_Type__c) != "Short-Term", ISBLANK(Text(Retention_Exception__c)) ),
TRUE,FALSE)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Is true if Job Type is "Long-Term" and they have completed 365 days since start date.
CustomField.label: Long-Term Retained
